pageTitle: UCLA Summer Camp for International students | MLI- Annex
pageDescription: Join the premier summer camp at UCLA for International students, MLI-Annex. Experience immersive English language programs, cultural activities, and campus life in Los Angeles. Enroll now for an unforgettable summer adventure!

immunizationRecordsDescription: MLI-Annex recommends that all campers be given Meningitis and Tetanus vaccinations before attending a junior camp. Please email your student's immunization record to MLI-Annex and mark clearly the student's full name.
medicationDescription: "Medication" is any substance a person takes to maintain and/or improve their health. This includes vitamins & natural remedies. Any medication not listed here will not be allowed at MLI-Annex Camps. All medication must be locked in the Health Room for the duration of Camp. All Medication will be administered as are in these tables.
